function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time internet access to look up today’s exact temperature in Moscow.  
For the most accurate and up‑to‑date information you could check:

* **Official Russian Meteorological Service** – e.g., Roshydromet (https://www.rgi.ru/).
* Popular weather websites/apps such as Weather.com, AccuWeather, or Yandex Meteorologiya.
* Your phone’s built‑in weather app set to “Moscow”.

These will give you the current temperature in degrees Celsius along with other details like humidity, wind speed, forecast, etc.
message.reasoning:
The user asks "What weather is now in Moscow, in Celsius?" They want current temperature. We need real-time data; we don't have direct API access. According to policy, we cannot provide inaccurate or fabricated info. So we should respond that I can't fetch live data but can suggest checking reliable sources like official meteorological services or apps.

We might also offer approximate typical temperatures if needed, but better not guess. Provide guidance.
